title: STAG2: Computational Analysis of Missense Variants Involved in Disease.
authors: Ros-Pardo, David; Gomez-Puertas, Paulino; Marcos-Alcalde, Inigo
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟分析STAG2及其错义突变体与DNA和蛋白互作的结构行为，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白-DNA互作建模且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The human STAG2 protein is an essential component of the cohesin complex involved in cellular processes of gene expression, DNA repair, and genomic integrity. Somatic mutations in the STAG2 sequence have been associated with various types of cancer, while congenital variants have been linked to developmental disorders such as Mullegama-Klein-Martinez syndrome, X-linked holoprosencephaly-13, and Cornelia de Lange syndrome. In the cohesin complex, the direct interaction of STAG2 with DNA and with NIPBL, RAD21, and CTCF proteins has been described. The function of STAG2 within the complex is still unknown, but it is related to its DNA binding capacity and is modulated by its binding to the other three proteins. Every missense variant described for STAG2 is located in regions involved in one of these interactions. In the present work, we model the structure of 12 missense variants described for STAG2, as well as two other variants of NIPBl and two of RAD21 located at STAG2 interaction zone, and then analyze their behavior through molecular dynamic simulations, comparing them with the same simulation of the wild-type protein. This will allow the effects of variants to be rationalized at the atomic level and provide clues as to how STAG2 functions in the cohesin complex.
abstract_zh: 人源STAG2蛋白是cohesin复合体的重要组成部分，参与基因表达、DNA修复和基因组完整性等细胞过程。STAG2序列中的体细胞突变与多种癌症相关，而先天性变异则与发育障碍如Mullegama-Klein-Martinez综合征、X连锁全前脑畸形-13和Cornelia de Lange综合征有关。在cohesin复合体中，已描述了STAG2与DNA及NIPBL、RAD21和CTCF蛋白的直接相互作用。STAG2在复合体中的功能尚不清楚，但与其DNA结合能力相关，并受其与其他三种蛋白结合的调节。已描述的STAG2每个错义变异均位于涉及这些相互作用之一的区域。在本研究中，我们对STAG2的12个错义变异以及位于STAG2相互作用区的NIPBL两个变异和RAD21两个变异的结构进行建模，并通过分子动力学模拟分析其行为，与野生型蛋白的相同模拟进行比较。这将有助于在原子水平上合理化变异效应，并为STAG2在cohesin复合体中的功能提供线索。
